mapper.sql: sys85_client_info_id AS client_info_id, sys85_company_nm AS company_name, sys85_org_nm AS org_name, sys85_pos_nm AS pos_name, sys85_client_nm AS client_name, sys85_moblie_telno AS moblie_telno
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys85_client_info WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(sys85_company_nm, sys85_org_nm, sys85_pos_nm, sys85_client_nm, sys85_moblie_telno, sys85_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY sys85_company_nm, sys85_org_nm, sys85_pos_nm, sys85_client_nm
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys85_client_info (sys85_client_info_id, sys85_company_nm, sys85_org_nm, sys85_pos_nm, sys85_client_nm, sys85_moblie_telno, sys85_reg_date) VALUES (#{clientInfoId}, #{req.companyName}, #{req.orgName}, #{req.posName}, #{req.clientName}, #{req.moblieTelno}, f_sysdate())
mapper.update: UPDATE sys85_client_info SET sys85_company_nm = #{req.companyName}, sys85_org_nm = #{req.orgName}, sys85_pos_nm = #{req.posName}, sys85_client_nm = #{req.clientName}, sys85_moblie_telno = #{req.moblieTelno} WHERE sys85_client_info_id = #{req.clientInfoId}
